tokens.name: cinema-black
tokens.usage: Cinema Black (#0c0c0c): Deep theatrical darkness, screening room ambiance. Used as background on `body`; text on `.logo-icon`, `.status-badge`, `.film-action:hover, .film-action:focus-visible`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: screen-white
